nom: Avène XeraCalm Eczema Calming Relief Balm

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including on hands, legs, arms and face, describe reduced dryness, itchiness and flaking, though one review with dry skin reported increased dryness and pimples after use.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive report that the fragrance-free, gentle formula calmed irritation without stinging, though one sensitive-skin user experienced initial stinging during an active flare-up.
segments.mature: One reviewer using it on aging, seemingly firmer-feeling skin on the legs after a week of daily use reports a visible improvement, though this is not framed as an anti-aging claim.

concerns.aging: A single reviewer noted her leg skin looked 'firmer' after a week of camping use, but no other reviewer discusses aging as a concern.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report noticeable, sometimes rapid, hydration and softness; one reviewer found it 'washes off easily' and prefers a thicker balm, and one reported skin felt more dry afterward.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report visible reduction in redness on the face, hands or forehead within days; no reviewer reports redness worsening.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describing 'broken' or compromised skin barriers report the balm restores comfort and reduces stinging on cracked or irritated skin, with one exception reporting a brief stinging period on an active flare before improvement.
concerns.spots: One reviewer used it on isolated dry eyelid and psoriasis-adjacent patches with success; this is a minor theme rather than a dedicated 'acne spot' concern.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports the product caused pimples, while no other reviewer reports breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Numerous reviewers explicitly state the balm is not greasy or oily despite being rich, though one reviewer felt the finish was slightly greasy.

aspects.libelle: Tube too small or hard to empty

extraits.titre: : Great for Sensitive and Eczema-Prone Skin
extraits.texte: XeraCalm Eczema Calming Relief Balm is a lifesaver for dry, irritated skin. The texture is rich and soothing, providing deep hydration without feeling greasy. It absorbs well and instantly calms redness and itchiness. Fragrance-free and gentle, making it perfect for sensitive and eczema-prone skin. The packaging is hygienic and easy to use. While it's a bit pricey, the effectiveness makes it worth it. Highly recommend for anyone struggling with dry, itchy skin or eczema!

extraits.titre: This is now a permanent staple in our household. I
extraits.texte: A Household Staple for Eczema and Dry, Patchy Skin! My son developed blotches of lighter patches right in the middle of his face. At first, I thought it was sunburn—it looked dry and irritated in a way I hadn't seen before. But after visiting the doctor, we were told it was eczema. We tried several different creams and treatments, and while some helped a little over time, nothing gave us fast relief… until we found Avène XeraCalm A.D Calming Relief Balm. This balm gave next-day results. The dry, patchy areas visibly calmed, the texture of his skin improved, and the irritation faded fast. And it didn't just work for him—it worked for me too. I also have eczema, and this balm delivers deep, soothing hydration that actually lasts, without any stinging or heaviness.

After days of trying to squeeze out the last few drops of my Tolerance Balm that my dermatologist recommended, I knew I needed to get more but I was also frustrated by my recurring bouts of facial eczema. I came across this new product, which would allow me to get about three times as much moisturizer for a lower price, and eventually decided to give it a try after some hesitation. At first it stung after application and I was worried that I'd made a huge mistake, but my face had been in an active flare-up and it took a few days to calm down. I had to go slowly and apply in gentle, broad strokes. Since the rough initial period, my skin looks and feels great! I use it under my low-dose tretinoin at night and haven't had any irritation. I'm so glad I took a chance on this with my sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: Perfect for winter time in Chicago
extraits.texte: My eczema usually gets really bad during the cold months and being in Chicago it is cold for six months of the year. My hands get dry and I get eczema patches everywhere which makes it painful to wash hands and cook. This cream is pretty good but it washes off easily. I use it mostly on the go, but I prefer La roche Posay because it is slightly thicker and leaves protective layer after washing hands.

I took this camping and used it every day for a week and saw the skin on my legs firm up, which was pretty cool. I like that you get a decent amount, more than the sunscreens I received. I prefer this to be honest, it has no sent and was great for my hands too. It feels high quality and I'd soend my own money on this.

I used this today when I had small flare of eczema and I haven't had any itching since I put it on this morning. I'm surprised. The texture was a little runny and separated but that could just be from first time opening it. I didn't notice any scent which you don't want with eczema anyways.
